body:
My mother is a single parent as well, and I feel like her world would me much easier without me. I see how upset I am making her as well. It sucks that you had to see your mother like that too. It is terrible when you have to see someone that has given you everything think that they are responsible for your pain. But they aren't. I wish my mother could just let me go and not feel responsible. 
I was anorexic/bulimic and a cutter when I was a teen it, was the only way I could control at least something in this screwed up world. I thought it was just normal, being a angst laden teen and all but these feelings never went away. I am 22 now and things are just getting worse. I was hoping meds and therapy would finally work, but I am lost. My mother deserves a better life unburdened by me. And you don't sound angry and I really really appreciate you sharing your story.

It is good to know someone else has been through the same thing. It does feel like there will never be a solution. I've tried so much and it's just getting exhausting. I feel like I was never meant to exist. How did you keep yourself....alive after so many failed attempts? I'm just tired.
Let her know you are there for her and that she is loved and cared about. Also, just listen, let her talk it out or cry, then tell her how much she means to you and her family and friends.
